trends.name: Modern Double-Breasted Suit
trends.description: The double-breasted suit returns with a refined, modern silhouette for both corporate and formal settings.
trends.pattern_details: Primarily solid colors, reflecting a move towards refined, personal corporate fits.

trends.name: Bold Color Statement Suits
trends.description: Suits in vibrant, unconventional colors are used to express personality at formal events like proms and weddings.
trends.pattern_details: Almost exclusively solid colors to let the bold hue be the focus of the outfit.

trends.name: The Velvet Jacket
trends.description: A plush velvet jacket, often worn as a separate, is the go-to for adding texture and luxury to winter and eveningwear.
trends.pattern_details: Solid color velvet is most common, emphasizing the fabric's rich texture and sheen.

trends.name: Soft Neutral Suiting
trends.description: Suiting in soft, versatile, and neutral tones is trending, especially for spring events and creating layered looks.
trends.pattern_details: Solid colors in various fabrics, embodying a soft minimalism aesthetic.

trends.name: Rich Textured Fabrics
trends.description: Suits and jackets are embracing opulent, textured fabrics like brocade and jacquard for a new sense of luxury.
trends.pattern_details: Features intricate, woven patterns inherent to brocade and jacquard fabrics.

trends.name: Sharp Cut Formalwear
trends.description: Modern suits for formal occasions feature sharp cuts and clean lines for an impactful, contemporary silhouette.
trends.pattern_details: Solid colors are preferred to emphasize the precision of the tailoring and modern detailing.

trends.name: The Straight-Leg Trouser
trends.description: The straight-leg trouser is making a comeback, signaling a shift away from overly slim fits towards a more balanced silhouette.
trends.pattern_details: Can be found in solid colors or as part of a full suit.

trends.name: Many Shades of Brown
trends.description: A wide spectrum of brown shades, from deep chocolate to light tan, is becoming a foundational color in the modern man's wardrobe.
trends.pattern_details: Popular in solid colors across various fabrics like wool, corduroy, and linen.

trends.name: The Polished Quarter-Zip
trends.description: The athletic quarter-zip sweater is being styled in a more refined way, layered under blazers or worn as a standalone smart-casual piece.
trends.pattern_details: Typically a solid knit, sometimes with a subtle texture like a waffle or rib knit.

trends.name: Layered Gilets
trends.description: Lightweight gilets (vests) are being used as a key layering piece under suit jackets and over shirts for a modern, functional look.
trends.pattern_details: Often features quilted or padded patterns for texture and warmth.

trends.name: Refined Trench Coats
trends.description: The classic trench coat is a key outerwear piece, worn over suits for a polished and timeless layered aesthetic.
trends.pattern_details: Solid color is the standard for this iconic outerwear piece.

trends.name: Elevated Neck Details
trends.description: The area around the neck is a new focus for accessorizing, using interesting collars, pins, and brooches to spruce up a suit.
trends.pattern_details: N/A - this trend is about adding hardware or unique shirt collar shapes.

trends.name: The Return of the Tie Pin
trends.description: The classic tie pin is re-emerging as a subtle yet sophisticated way to add a point of interest and detail to a formal look.
trends.pattern_details: N/A - this is a metallic accessory for a tie.

trends.name: Statement Lapel Brooches
trends.description: Brooches are being worn on lapels to add a touch of personality and artistry to otherwise simple suits and blazers.
trends.pattern_details: Can range from abstract metallic shapes to intricate, jeweled designs.

trends.name: The 'Do-It-All' Loafer
trends.description: Versatile loafers are the go-to footwear, easily transitioning from smart-casual with chinos to more formal suit-and-tie occasions.
trends.pattern_details: Typically solid leather or suede, with classic penny or tassel details.

trends.name: Luxe Tone Eveningwear
trends.description: For evening events and weddings, suits in rich, luxurious jewel tones create a sophisticated and memorable look.
trends.pattern_details: Solid colors in fabrics with a slight sheen, like satin or high-quality wool.

trends.name: The Deconstructed Corporate Fit
trends.description: Office wear is evolving into a more personal, deconstructed look, often pairing a tailored blazer with smart chinos or dress pants.
trends.pattern_details: Mixing solid separates, such as a navy blazer with khaki chinos.

trends.name: The Modern Tuxedo
trends.description: The tuxedo remains a staple for the most formal events, updated with sharper cuts and modern detailing for a contemporary feel.
trends.pattern_details: Traditionally solid with satin lapels, but modern interpretations may include subtle textures.

trends.name: The Tiny Watch
trends.description: In a move away from oversized timepieces, smaller, more discreet watches are becoming the stylish choice for accessorizing.
trends.pattern_details: N/A - this is a metallic accessory, often with a leather or metal strap.

trends.name: Heritage Craftsmanship
trends.description: A focus on high-quality, durable materials and traditional tailoring techniques is a key trend, emphasizing timeless style.
trends.pattern_details: Classic patterns like herringbone, houndstooth, and glen plaid are associated with this trend.

trends.name: Soft Minimalism
trends.description: This trend focuses on clean lines, uncluttered silhouettes, and a palette of soft, muted colors for an intentional and understated look.
trends.pattern_details: Strictly solid colors with an emphasis on fabric quality and drape.

trends.name: Polished Leather Dress Shoes
trends.description: A classic, well-made leather dress shoe in an Oxford or Derby style is essential for formal office events and professional settings.
trends.pattern_details: Solid, polished leather is the standard for a neat and professional appearance.
